name: Deflecting Edge's Sword-control discount and combat damage prevention
notes: Seeds Clarent, Sword of Peace onto the field to trigger the Sword-control discount, then plays Deflecting Edge for 0 reserve and confirms the prevention effect lands on the chosen unit.

rulesClauses: This card costs 1 less to activate if you control a Sword weapon.
Prevent the next 3 combat damage that would be dealt to target unit this turn.
